name: SplitPane
label: Split pane
description: Two resizable regions with a draggable, keyboard-operable divider between them.

props.name: children
props.description: The two panes, in order. Children beyond the first two are ignored.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the panes sit: side by side, or stacked.

props.name: split
props.description: First pane's share as a percentage (controlled). Pair with `onSplitChange`.

props.name: defaultSplit
props.description: First pane's share as a percentage (uncontrolled initial value).

props.name: minSplit
props.description: Smallest share the first pane can be dragged to, as a percentage.

props.name: maxSplit
props.description: Largest share the first pane can be dragged to, as a percentage.

props.name: onSplitChange
props.description: Fires with the new percentage on every drag step or keyboard resize.

props.name: separatorLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the resize handle.
